name: 360 ONE WAM Ltd
about: IIFL Wealth Management Limited, founded in 2008, is one of the largest private wealth management firms in India. The company mainly acts as wealth manager and provides services relating to financial products distribution, advisory, portfolio management services by mobilizing funds and assets of various classes of investors including High Networth Individuals. key_points: Business Verticals: a) Wealth Management: [1] [2] [3] The company is one of India’s largest wealth managers . The platform offers discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management, product distribution across mutual funds, AIFs, PMS and global investments, along with lending, corporate treasury and estate planning services. It provides advice-oriented wealth management solutions for UHNIs, with a primary focus on clients with Rs. 50+ Cr of investable assets. The platform also serves 600+ corporate treasuries and is expanding its footprint to serve the growing HNI segment with Rs. 10-50 Cr in assets.

profile.summary: 360 One Wam Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides wealth and asset management services in India. It operates through the Wealth Management and Asset Management segments. The Wealth Management segment engages in the distribution of financial products, advisory, broking and research, discretionary and non-discretionary portfolio management services, corporate treasury solutions, estate planning, and managing financial products in advisory. This segment is also involved in lending and investment activities. The Asset Management segment engages in the management of pooled funds under various products and structures, such as mutual funds, alternative asset funds, portfolio management and related activities, including advisory and offshore spanning public and private equity, fixed income, and real assets. It serves ultra-high net worth individuals, family offices, and institutional clients. The company was formerly known as IIFL Wealth Management Limited and changed its name to 360 One Wam Limited in January 2023. 360 One Wam Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Mumbai, India.
